narrative_purpose: Contrasts Earth's dead rock record with Pandora's living archive: on one side dull silent stone strata holding fossils, on the other a luminous neural tree whose glowing roots thread living layers of memory - the chapter's bridge between geology and Eywa.
subject: A split natural scene. On the left, dull grey layered rock strata with faint pale fossil shapes pressed silently into the stone - lifeless and still. On the right, the same depth of ground is alive: a vast ancient tree sends luminous cyan and teal roots downward through glowing layered soil, and within each glowing layer faint shapes drift like preserved memories, connected by a web of fine bioluminescent threads climbing back up into the tree.
scene: A cutaway of the ground itself, dead rock meeting living network underground, the surface above lost in dark forest haze.
camera: A tall cross-sectional view looking at the underground layers head-on, the dead-rock side and the living-network side meeting near the center.
light: Left side dim and cold, almost lightless grey; right side glowing from within with cyan and teal bioluminescence radiating up the roots and threads; deep indigo shadow binding them.
palette: Cold desaturated stone-grey on the dead side, vivid cyan and living-teal glow on the living side, scarce magenta sparks among the drifting memory-shapes, void-indigo ground.
style: Painterly speculative-biology plate, textured rock against luminous organic network.
detail_level: Crisp glowing roots, threads, and memory-motes on the living side; the dead side flatter and duller by deliberate contrast; surface above dissolving into haze.
composition: A near-central vertical divide between dull strata (left) and glowing rooted network (right), roots and threads drawing the eye downward then back up, balanced halves.
consistency_notes: Cool Pandora palette with bioluminescent key from the living network; the dead-rock side is deliberately desaturated to read as 'silent record'. Restrained magenta accents only.
negative_prompt: no text, no lettering, no numbers, no labels, no arrows, no infographic chrome, no photographic or 3D-render look, no lens flares, no cartoon or anime style
